name: Under the Engine

engine.type: Air-cooled single-cylinder four-stroke, unit construction (crank, generator, starters, clutch and gearbox in one crankcase)
engine.valvetrain: Chain-driven single overhead cam, two valves, rocker arms with screw adjusters
engine.ignition: Magneto flywheel, exciter coil, pickup coil, AC-CDI, ignition coil
starting: Kickstarter (helical spline, kick idle gear lugged to clutch basket)
Electric starter via reduction gear and roller one-way clutch
engine.clutch: Wet multi-plate, 5 friction plates, 4 steel plates, 4 springs, cable lifter and push rod through the mainshaft
engine.gearbox: 5-speed constant mesh, return shift 1-N-2-3-4-5, shift drum with 3 channels, 3 forks, star detent with ground neutral ridge
engine.note: Tooth counts and dimensions are representative of 125 cc commuter engines, not one manufacturer's drawings. Clutch lift and dog travel are exaggerated in the animation.

shiftDrum.neutral: Half step (30 deg) between 1st and 2nd, held by a ground-flat ridge on the star cam

valveTiming_crankDeg.cycle: 0 = TDC at start of intake; 0-180 intake, 180-360 compression, 360-540 power, 540-720 exhaust

sources: Video 1 transcript: kickstarter, self-starter and one-way roller clutch, stator, exciter coil, CDI, pickup coil, ignition coil, timing chain, counterbalance, clutch, transmission
